problem: Possible contradiction: Visit Corsica and Corse Net Infos both state the Ajaccio appellation requires a minimum of 60 percent Sciaccarellu in the blend for reds and rosés. The 40 percent figure appears in the older (2011) Ajaccio rules; the 2019 rules list sciaccarello as a principal grape with a minimum share whose figure could not be read from the extracted PDF text. Verify against the current Ajaccio cahier before keeping 40 percent.
